about: People who asked to be left off PointCast pickleball rankings. Each entry is the SHA-256 of the name as normalized by src/lib/pickleball-rankings/rules.mjs (the same normalization elsegundo.xyz uses), so this public file never repeats a name. A listed name is dropped from every tier: national, global, regional and level. Partners' pages show 'a player who asked to be left out'. Honor requests the same day, and pass them to the source ladder so it drops them too.
